Spawn: MAKETYPE_CRITICAL_EFFECT (WorldObjects.cpp:1176-1182) uses g_session.GetDamageSpriteName() = BaseMsg = `이팩트\msg` (ClientTiming.cpp:784-806, DamageSkinInfo GetDamageResourceName) with animation/action index 2, type 15. Pose: AM_SETPOS critical case (MsgEffect.cpp:1825-1835): position.y -= 12, curMotion 1, scale/m_scale 3.0, depthLayer -5 (digits are -2, MsgEffect.cpp:1772), render.color 0xFFAAAAAA, m_baseY = y. Timeline: OnProcess (MsgEffect.cpp:377-395): scale = 3.0 - elapsed * 0.24 * 0.6 down to 1.0, curMotion = int(elapsed * g_depthAverageHalf) % frames = int(elapsed * 0.5) % 15 (g_depthAverageHalf = 0.5, MapSkyMgr.cpp:27), alpha 255 - elapsed * 3.45, lifetime 70. FollowOwner (MsgEffect.cpp:1312-1329) makes it follow the target x/z with blendFlags 0x200; the draw is RSF_ALPHA|RSF_DEPTH_SORTED (GameObject.cpp:359-399). Asset: data\sprite\이팩트\msg.spr image 3 (70x60) and msg.act action 2 (15 motions, cell (x, -3), image 3, zoom 1.0) as shipped in data.grf; the x offsets are the per-motion jitter [0,-10,10,-8,8,-6,6,-4,4,-2,2,-1,1,0,0].
